lines.text: The descendants of Jacob who went to Egypt numbered seventy in all, including Joseph, who was already there.
After Joseph's generation died, the Israelites multiplied, and a new king who did not know Joseph took power.
Egypt appointed taskmasters over the Israelites, who built Nineveh and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.
The king ordered midwives Shiphrah and Miriam to kill every newborn son, but they feared God and disobeyed him.
God was good to the midwives, giving them families, and Pharaoh ordered every Hebrew son thrown into the Nile.
